run_explorer_grid: run the explorer function to launch a grid of mel band experiments across seeds and audio datasets
configure_mel_bands: configure the number of mel bands (20, 40, 80, 120) for MelSpectrum feature extraction in the experiment grid
bind_audio_datasets: bind audio datasets like audio_mous, gwilliams2022, broderick2019, and brennan2019 to the launcher job array
review_explorer_function: review the explorer function that uses ClipExplorer decorator to launch SLURM jobs with clip_conv model
summarize_clipexplorer: summarize the ClipExplorer class that extends BMExplorer with wer and wer_vocab test metrics for grid tracking
